name: Algal oil (vegan omega-3)
note: EPA+DHA varies by product - edit to match label.

name: Aluminium hydroxide (as phosphate binder)
note: No calcium; long-term use can cause aluminium toxicity. Binding is a human-derived estimate; give only as prescribed by your vet, mixed into meals.

name: Bonza vegan kibble
note: Bonza vegan kibble, from bonza.dog product page (as fed): protein 25%, fat 12.5%, fibre 4.5%, ash 7.5%, moisture 9%, Ca 0.9%, P 0.7%, DHA 0.22% + EPA 0.005%, 3581 kcal/kg. Vitamins/choline = ADDED amounts per kg (ingredients add more). Na, K, Mg not declared. Also adds taurine 1500 mg/kg, L-carnitine, DL-methionine 5000 mg/kg (urine-acidifying), Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, I, Se. Bonza's help-centre lists slightly different older figures (protein 25.2%, P 0.87%, 345 kcal/100 g) - check your bag.

name: Calcium acetate (as phosphate binder)
note: Adds calcium (25%). Binding is a human-derived estimate; give only as prescribed by your vet, mixed into meals.

name: Calcium carbonate
note: Phosphorus-free calcium; mild alkali.

name: Calcium carbonate (as phosphate binder)
note: Adds calcium (40%). Binding is a human-derived estimate; give only as prescribed by your vet, mixed into meals.

name: Cauldron Authentic Tofu (organic, 396 g)
note: Label per 100 g: 118 kcal, protein 13 g, fat 7.1 g, carb 1.0 g, fibre 1.9 g, salt 0.03 g, calcium 401 mg (calcium sulphate set). NOT on label, ESTIMATED from USDA firm calcium-set tofu scaled to 13 g protein: phosphorus 143 mg, potassium 178 mg, magnesium 44 mg; water by difference. Vitamins unknown.

name: Coconut oil
note: Approx. USDA. Mostly saturated (MCT); almost no essential fatty acids. Can cause GI upset - introduce slowly.

name: Egg white, cooked (boiled/poached, no fat)
note: Based on USDA raw egg white: boiling or poaching without fat barely changes composition per 100 g. Small B-vitamin losses with heat; if fried, add the oil separately.

name: Eggshell powder
note: Approximate.

name: Engevita organic yeast flakes (purple)
note: Marigold Engevita nutritional yeast flakes, per 100 g dry (manufacturer). Calcium, PHOSPHORUS, potassium and magnesium not declared - yeast is a notable phosphorus source, so treat as unknown, not zero. B6, B12 not listed. Also iron 6 mg, biotin 30 ug.

name: Engevita yeast flakes + B12 (blue)
note: Marigold Engevita nutritional yeast flakes, per 100 g dry (manufacturer). Calcium, PHOSPHORUS, potassium and magnesium not declared - yeast is a notable phosphorus source, so treat as unknown, not zero. Also zinc 120 mg, biotin 196 ug.

name: Engevita yeast flakes protein & fibre (pink)
note: Marigold Engevita nutritional yeast flakes, per 100 g dry (manufacturer). Calcium, PHOSPHORUS, potassium and magnesium not declared - yeast is a notable phosphorus source, so treat as unknown, not zero. B12 not listed.

name: Engevita yeast flakes vitamin D & B12 (green)
note: Marigold Engevita nutritional yeast flakes, per 100 g dry (manufacturer). Calcium, PHOSPHORUS, potassium and magnesium not declared - yeast is a notable phosphorus source, so treat as unknown, not zero. Vitamin D 100 ug = 4000 IU/100 g - check against the AAFCO max; do not use for vitamin D without your vet. Also zinc 247 mg.

name: Fish oil (salmon)
note: EPA+DHA varies by product - edit to match label.

name: Hemp seed oil
note: Typical values. Good linoleic acid + some ALA; EPA+DHA = 0.

name: Just Be Kind vegan supplement
note: Just Be Kind vitamin/mineral supplement (vegan-dogfood.co.uk). Label: protein 26.3%, fat 1%, fibre 0.5%, ash 45.8%, Ca 10.8%, P 3.1%, Na 2.5%; additives per kg as declared. Moisture not declared (5% assumed) -> energy estimated. Vitamin D, K, Mg not declared. Also adds Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, I, Se, taurine, L-carnitine, lysine, threonine, tryptophan, valine and DL-METHIONINE 15% (urine-acidifying - discuss with your vet for a CKD dog). High vitamin A (9000 IU/100 g). Dose as per label.

name: Just Be Kind vegan wet dog food (290 g tray)
note: From label (as fed). Ca, P, Na, K, Mg not declared - ask info@justbekind.co.uk. Vitamins D3, E, B1, B12, niacin are the ADDED amounts only (ingredients add a little more). Contains algae; EPA+DHA not stated. Also adds taurine, L-carnitine, zinc, copper, iodine, selenium, methionine, tryptophan.

name: Linseed (flaxseed) oil
note: Approx. USDA. Richest plant source of ALA, but EPA+DHA = 0 (poor conversion in dogs). Oxidises quickly - keep refrigerated.

name: Mushrooms, chestnut (crimini), raw weight
note: USDA SR26 11266 (Mushrooms, brown, italian, or crimini, raw). Weigh raw, then cook. Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD.

name: Mushrooms, oyster, raw weight
note: USDA SR26 11987 (Mushrooms, oyster, raw). Weigh raw, then cook. Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD.

name: Mushrooms, portobello, grilled
note: USDA SR26 11243 (Mushrooms, portabella, grilled). Cooked weight, not UV-treated (UV 'vitamin D' mushrooms are much higher in vitamin D). Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD.

name: Mushrooms, shiitake, cooked
note: USDA SR26 11269 (Mushrooms, shiitake, cooked, without salt). Cooked weight; always cook shiitake (raw can cause skin rash). Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD.

name: Mushrooms, white (button), boiled
note: USDA SR26 11261 (Mushrooms, white, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt). Cooked weight. Plain only - no butter, oil, salt, garlic or onion. Shop-bought culinary mushrooms only; never wild-picked. Higher in potassium and phosphorus than most vegetables - keep portions small in CKD.

name: Potassium citrate (monohydrate)
note: Potassium + alkaliniser.

name: Rapeseed oil
note: Approx. USDA canola oil. Contains ALA (plant omega-3), which dogs convert poorly to EPA/DHA, so EPA+DHA = 0.

name: Rice, white, raw (dry, unenriched)
note: Dry weight before cooking; approx. USDA long-grain, unenriched. ~1 g dry = ~2.8 g cooked.

name: Sodium bicarbonate
note: Alkaliniser; adds sodium.

name: Spinach, boiled
note: High oxalate and potassium.

name: Tofu, firm (calcium-set)
note: Calcium varies hugely with coagulant - check label.

name: Walnut oil
note: Approx. USDA. Linoleic acid + some ALA; EPA+DHA = 0.
